# Let's parse the content of the file to extract the song titles and artists.
# The format appears to be "- <Song Title> by <Artist(s)>" per line (ignoring the header line).

import re

old_songs_lines = old_songs_file["content"].splitlines()
old_songs = []
for line in old_songs_lines:
    match = re.match(r"- (.+) by (.+)", line.strip())
    if match:
        title = match.group(1).strip()
        artists = [artist.strip() for artist in match.group(2).split(",")]
        old_songs.append({"title": title, "artists": artists})

print(old_songs)  # List of dicts: {"title": ..., "artists": [...]}
